supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: significant 2D extension beyond the lateral orbital margins

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: noticeable contrast between the lighter pigmentation of the muzzle and the dark/high-melanin periocular and forehead regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thick with a visible structural droop below the maxillary line

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: distinct pale, circular depigmented spot or lesion located on the nasal tip/bridge
